notes.title: Added Full Controller Support, Full Screen Support, And More!
notes.content:
Updates 1 and 2 to Asteroids Millennium have been released! These latest updates include [b]full controller support[/b], [b]full screen support[/b], some bug fixes, and other minor game play improvements!

Here is a complete list of updates:
[list]
[*] added full controller support for Windows and Linux---this has been successfully tested with the Logitech F710, XBox 360, Playstation DS4, and Logitech Extreme 3D controllers
[*] added full screen support
[*] added slight gradual acceleration when turning the ship with keyboard controls for greater accuracy
[*] player can now either hold or repeatedly press the fire button to shoot
[*] added 5 new backdrops
[*] made minor improvements to some graphical effects
[*] addressed some bugs that may cause graphical glitches on some systems
[*] other minor bugfixes
[/list]

Enjoy!
